messages.author: 4b63675507b4aa11
messages.subject: Nimble 0.3-1 is broken
parts:
I worked file yesterday. Today when I tried to load it,  I got
" 
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object '/home/shige/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.2/nimble/libs/nimble.so':
  /home/shige/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.2/nimble/CppCode/libnimble.so: undefined symbol: dpotrf_
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘nimble’
"

When I removed and tried to reinstall, I got the same error. Is it possible that the new version of igraph package broke it?

Shige

messages.author: 99aa11b224ba9e9e
messages.subject: Re: Nimble 0.3-1 is broken
parts:
Yes Shige, that appears to be the case.

I just upgraded my igraph package (from 0.7.1 to the latest on CRAN, which is 1.0.0), and it broke my version of NIMBLE as well.  We will look into what has changed and aim to remedy this.

For the meantime, I was able to get NIMBLE working again by reverting back to version 0.7.1 of igraph.  The old igraph source packages are available here.

Cheers,
Daniel

messages.author: 99aa11b224ba9e9e
messages.subject: Re: Nimble 0.3-1 is broken
parts:
NIMBLE users, we apologize for the problem the new version of igraph (1.0.x) has caused with NIMBLE.  We've identified the problem, which will be fixed internally in the soon-upcoming version 0.4 release of NIMBLE.

In the meantime, please continue to use NIMBLE with the older 0.7.1 version of igraph.

Thanks,
Daniel
NIMBLE Development Team
